annotations.title: AI support ticket to KB article

description: AI support ticket to KB article — Turn a resolved support ticket, chat transcript or troubleshooting notes into a help-center article: title, summary, symptoms, cause, numbered resolution steps, workarounds, applies-to, keywords, related questions and when to escalate, plus ready-to-paste Markdown. Personal data is removed by the model and scrubbed again offline. text= required; optional product= and audience=customer|agent. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. Customer: after the update the app keeps logging me out every few minutes. Agent: please clear the browser cookies for our site and sign in again. Customer: that fixed it, thanks!

name: ai_kb_article
